signature: “MACHT ANTONI SCHNITZE [sic] MDLXXXXIIII; [later mark:] BOHLAND & FUCHS / GRASLITZ / 9”
pitch: B-flat; with assoc. mp plays nearly 100 cents above a=440; with modern-style sackbut mp, plays ca. 80 cents above a=440.bo 9.6, be 102-105, le ca. 2583, bell thickness .26/.20/.34
dimensions: bo 9.6, be 102-105, le ca. 2583, bell thickness .26/.20/.34
literature: Myers A 1990: 144 (photo); Myers A 1990: 144; Myers 1993; Waterhouse 1993: 360; Carter 2012: 315, 317 (photo); Vereecke 2016: 148–50, 240–43; MINIM-UK.
remarks: “[F]lat bell stay loosely pinned at bell-pipe end; tubular slide stays; stay of outer loosely fixed at both ends and itself telescopic; string ring at bell-bow” ; bell-stay engraved; bell sec. ferrules with foliage design. Slide sec. ferrules decorated with turned incisions; tubular slide stays, telescopic; sleeve over tear in mouthpipe; restored by Gottfried Buechel, Bonn, ca. 1984. Examined by Carter, August 2003.
